executors.merge: tools.merge_with_bridge_receipt:merge_with_bridge_receipt(apply=True, carry_forward, accepted_queue_checker): writes its own MAGMA receipt, fresh gate, verify_carry_forward_apply, then gh pr merge
executors.idle: tools.idle_consensus_auto_merge:evaluate_auto_merge_gate(apply=True, carry_forward, receipt_bundle_path): consumes a MAGMA receipt written by the actual writer, verify_carry_forward_apply, then gh pr merge

harness: real git history on the allowlisted path of the receipt corpus MAGMA route; synthetic strict GitHub (no live call) with a base ref that can move for the late pre-effect read only; queue observation read at call time

verdicts.merge: exactly one gh pr merge, --match-head-commit at the proposed head, never the approved head; carry_apply_verification ok with atomic_base_guard false
verdicts.refuse: no gh pr merge command at all and a non-ok report or a raised refusal

when.before: merge executor: change applied before the executor runs; idle executor: change applied after the actual writer wrote the legit receipt and before the apply call
when.after_receipt: merge executor: change applied right before its second snapshot read, after its receipt files exist; idle executor: as before
when.late_base: the base ref moves only for the read inside verify_carry_forward_apply (isolates the late pre-effect check)

mutations.old_head_objection: recognized RCO changes_requested decision bound to the approved head
mutations.new_head_objection: recognized RCO changes_requested decision bound to the proposed head
mutations.benign_note: unrelated informational message under another task (must not refuse)
mutations.ci_failed: the bound app's unified run fails at the proposed head
mutations.late_base_moved: base ref tip differs at the late pre-effect read
mutations.unbound_votes: original votes carry no reviewed basis
mutations.votes_bound_to_consistent_live_base: original votes bound to a basis whose base is the live base; merge-base(live base, approved head) is the old base, so diff and patch-id are unchanged (a truthful, git-consistent basis)
mutations.votes_bound_to_other_diff: original votes bound to a basis with another diff digest and patch-id (resealed vote digest)
mutations.vote_pr_true: original vote payload PR field JSON true for PR 1
mutations.vote_pr_float: original vote payload PR field as a float

votes_bound_to_consistent_live_base.note: control; first run expected refuse, corrected: the bound basis is git-consistent (same merge-base, diff and patch-id), so carrying it is correct; on the idle path the receipt written before the change no longer rederives (refused, covered by the receipt route)

empty_expected_base.note: RCO2 11:32Z: empty expected_base_sha refuses before any effect

foreign_valid_receipt.note: RCO2 11:32Z: a valid receipt from a different carry (other task and ledger) on the idle path
